entries.title: PostReady: PR #757 — feat(carousel): Save — autosave drafts + reload on open
entries.description: Second step of Generate → Save → Publish: carousel work persists. Adds carousels table (migration 68), /api/carousel/draft GET/PUT endpoint, and autosave on every edit with reload on re-open.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #758 — fix(carousel): move card actions off card, merge AI buttons, bigger logo
entries.description: Moved per-card action buttons off the card canvas to avoid overlap with content, merged the two AI action buttons into one, and increased logo size in the Carousel Creator editor.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #759 — feat(carousel): Stage 1 publish — render cards to real PNGs + Download
entries.description: Stage 1 of the Carousel Creator Publish step: renders each carousel card to a real PNG via canvas capture and bundles them into a ZIP for download. Generate → Save → Publish pipeline now has all three stages functional.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #760 — feat(carousel): real business name on cards + New button
entries.description: Carousel Creator now uses the user's real business name on cards instead of placeholder text, and adds a New Carousel button for quickly starting a fresh project.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #761 — feat(carousel): drag-and-drop desktop image upload
entries.description: Added native drag-and-drop desktop image upload to the Carousel Creator, allowing users to drop image files directly onto cards for photo carousel creation.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #762 — feat(carousel): composite uploaded photos into exported PNG
entries.description: Carousel Creator now composites user-uploaded photos into the exported PNG at publish time, so photo carousels render correctly in the downloaded output ZIP.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #763 — fix: harden anti-frame guard for Seedream outpaint masters
entries.description: Hardened the anti-frame guard for Seedream outpaint master generation to prevent framing artifacts in generated images, improving output quality for image creation workflows.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #767 — feat: per-role typography for carousel card renderer
entries.description: Added per-role typography to the carousel card renderer so each card role (Headline, Body, CTA, etc.) uses its own font style, improving visual hierarchy in generated carousels.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #768 — feat(carousel): use the client's real Brand Kit colors and logo
entries.description: Carousel Creator now pulls colors and the logo directly from the client's Brand Kit, so every generated carousel is automatically on-brand without manual configuration.

entries.title: PostReady: PR #769 — feat: restyle "Finishing touches" section into a single card
entries.description: Restyled the "Finishing touches" section in the Carousel Creator into a compact single card layout, reducing visual clutter and improving the inspector panel's usability.
